WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, p.category AS category_as_was, p.subcategory, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, p.category, p.subcategory, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, n.category_as_was, n.subcategory, ROUND(SUM(n.net_sales),2) AS net_sales, count(*) AS n
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12 AND n.category_as_was ILIKE '%garden%'
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4
ORDER BY 2,3,4

SELECT 'dup_sales_line_id' AS chk, count(*) - count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS v FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-04-27'
UNION ALL SELECT 'dup_receipt_line', count(*) - count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-04-27'
UNION ALL SELECT 'dup_return_line', count(*) - count(DISTINCT return_line_id) FROM fact_return_line WHERE return_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-04-27'
UNION ALL SELECT 'returns_orphan', count(*) FROM fact_return_line r LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id WHERE f.sales_line_id IS NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 'web_lines_no_order', count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f LEFT JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id WHERE f.channel_code = 'WB' AND w.web_order_id IS NULL

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
mine AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_period, SUM(n.net_sales) AS mine
    FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12 GROUP BY 1
),
ctrl AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_period, SUM(r.net_sales) AS ctrl
    FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.business_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12 GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT m.fiscal_period, m.mine, c.ctrl, m.mine - c.ctrl AS gap FROM mine m JOIN ctrl c USING (fiscal_period) ORDER BY 1
SELECT fiscal_period, period_start_date, period_end_date, weeks_in_period, fully_loaded FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12 ORDER BY 1

WITH multi AS (
  SELECT sku, string_agg(DISTINCT category, ' > ') AS cats, string_agg(DISTINCT subcategory, ',') AS subs, min(valid_from) mn, max(valid_from) mx
  FROM dim_product GROUP BY sku HAVING count(DISTINCT category) > 1)
SELECT cats, subs, count(*) AS skus, min(mx) AS first_change, max(mx) AS last_change FROM multi GROUP BY 1,2

SELECT count(*) AS lines, sum(CASE WHEN f.sale_date BETWEEN p.valid_from AND p.valid_to THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS version_mismatch,
       sum(CASE WHEN p.category='Garden' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS garden_lines
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-04-27'

SELECT w.status, count(*) AS lines, sum(f.net_amount) AS net, min(f.sale_date) AS d0, max(f.sale_date) AS d1, sum(CASE WHEN w.dispatch_ts_utc IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_dispatch
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-20' AND DATE '2025-05-04'
GROUP BY 1
